items.title: U.S., China to lower tariffs on $60 billion of goods. Here's what qualifies
items.summary: BEIJING — The U.S. and China are planning to reduce tariffs on $30 billion worth of goods from each country, according to government announcements from both sides Monday.

items.title: Trump-Xi summit analysis: 'Tangible outcomes' needed for U.S.-China truce to hold
items.summary: BEIJING — In a summit dominated by spectacle , the U.S. and China have essentially agreed to keep talking.

items.title: Debt-hungry AI companies face increased risk as bond yields spike
items.summary: With Treasury yields climbing this week to their highest levels since 2007, companies reliant on debt are poised to see their borrowing costs rise.

items.title: China posts weakest industrial profit growth this year, expanding 4.2% in August
items.summary: China's industrial profits grew at their weakest pace this year, expanding just 4.2% in August from a year earlier, official data released Monday showed, as manufacturers grapple with persistent weakness in consumer demand and a sustained rise in energy costs.
